task_summary: Inspect the uploaded ancient-sediment FASTA, remove duplicate sequences, keep records between 15 and 22 nucleotides, and report SeqKit statistics for the retained sequences while preserving intermediate FASTA files.

steps.reason: Inspect the uploaded ancient-sediment FASTA and capture its initial SeqKit statistics before filtering.
Remove duplicate FASTA records by sequence content, producing an intermediate non-redundant FASTA.
Retain only nucleotide records between 15 and 22 nucleotides, producing the filtered intermediate FASTA.
Generate machine-readable SeqKit statistics for the retained length-filtered, de-duplicated sequences.
